issues.summary: Daehan Precision needed same-day customs clearance and delivery of industrial sensors in container HMLU6425478 (HBL MFCIM260019 / MBL HMLU260703) to avoid a production line stop the next day.

decisions.summary: Jiwoo Han accepted Harbor Gate's USD 150 expedite fee for same-day clearance of HBL MFCIM260019, to be invoiced to Meridian Freight.

tasks.summary: Expedite import clearance of container HMLU6425478 (HBL MFCIM260019) the same day; release obtained at 15:40 on 2026-05-06.
Send the D/O for container HMLU6425478 (HBL MFCIM260019) to Jiwoo Han as soon as it is ready.
Review and approve Thomas Kwon's request that Meridian absorb the USD 150 Harbor Gate expedite fee as goodwill instead of billing Daehan Precision.
Keep a truck ready for same-day pick-up of container HMLU6425478 and coordinate delivery with Soyeon Moon at Daehan Precision.

deadlines.what: Same-day delivery of industrial sensors (container HMLU6425478) to Daehan Precision plant to avoid line stop on 2026-05-07.
